unsupported.groupInfo_joining_code: DIV-1: a GroupInfoRequest with a joining code is refused; preauthorized users are not read
unsupported.reportAbuse_with_abusive_messages: DIV-9: a report attaching an AbusiveMessage is refused (its Frank cannot yet be verified) - metadata-only reports are accepted
unsupported.update_wire_endpoint_mixed_commits: DIV-10: a Commit is applied when it carries participant-list changes, room-policy changes, or both (one change per policy component; a role list never beside a participant-list change, room-policy-04 §3), alone or with Add and Remove proposals beside it; proposals by reference are accepted only when they are the ones this hub holds for a member's leave. A second change of one policy component, a role list beside a participant-list change, a Commit with no change, any other proposal type and any other proposal by reference are refused
